Full Statement: Art and Design
Grades K-2
Students will generate, develop, and refine artistic work.
Create
Explore studio skills, techniques, materials, tools, and elements and principles of art and design.
Describe process and choices while creating art.
Create works of art that introduce students to media, care of tools, and basic craftsmanship skills.
Students will develop, refine, and convey meaning through the production and presentation of artistic work.
Present
Explore and develop meaning by viewing personal, historical, and contemporary art.
Explain artwork through verbal and/or written descriptions using art and design vocabulary.
Share artwork through a presentation or exhibit.
Students will critically interpret intent and meaning in order to evaluate artistic work.
Respond
Identify details, basic elements, and subject matter of an artwork.
Distinguish between reality and imaginary when describing a work of art.
Use details and subject matter to interpret an artwork’s mood or meaning.
Determine the artist’s intent by identifying the details and subject matter.
Use learned art and design vocabulary to express individual opinion of a work.
Students will relate their artistic work with prior experience and external context.
Connect
Recognize and demonstrate relationships between art and design, and other disciplines.
Recognize art and design careers.
Understand that people from different times and places have made art and design for a variety of reasons.

Create

Respond
Describe details, subject matter, and the context of an artwork.
Compare and contrast how the use of media can influence ideas.
Use details, subject matter, and context to interpret an artwork’s mood or meaning.
Determine an artist’s intent by identifying the details, subject matter, and context of an artwork.
Determine and apply criteria for evaluating artworks and practice constructive feedback.
Students will relate their artistic work with prior experience and external context.
Connect
Describe and demonstrate relationships between art and design, and their learning in other disciplines.
Identify art and design processes in a variety of careers.
Explain how art and design are used to communicate ideas, beliefs, and values of groups and individuals.
